data.name: Gavrilla
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'gavros', meaning 'grave' or 'serious', Gavrilla is a name with strong roots in the Western spiritual tradition. This name was given to girls born into families with a warrior spirit, who were expected to display courage and determination in the face of adversity. In the biblical context, Gavrilla can be associated with the courageous and unwavering faith of the Biblical character Deborah, who led the Israelites to victory in battle.
